summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 25 条 X 动态、1 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 11 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Swyx · AI Engineer 社区与 Latent Space 主理人
featured.summaryEn: Swyx used the weekend to push the annual AI Engineering Survey, but the more interesting signal was operational: Devin analyzed the registered attendee list for the AI Engineer Conference and produced a live chart that he called the best data-driven storytelling he has seen about the community. The meta-point is that the AI builder ecosystem is starting to use agents to understand and narrate itself.
featured.insightZh: Swyx 这次主要在为年度 AI Engineering Survey 做最后召集，同时提到一个很有意思的细节：他们让 Devin 分析 AI Engineer Conference 的注册参会名单，并生成了一张实时图表，结果成为他见过最好的「数据驱动社区叙事」。信号在于，AI builder 社区本身也在用 agent 分析自己的结构、讲清楚谁正在聚集、社区会往哪里走。

featured.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程创作者
featured.summaryEn: Peter Yang flagged what looked like a calendar security issue: someone named “Nora” had somehow booked a meeting with him, and he asked Cal.com-related people to investigate. The small incident matters because agentic scheduling, automated booking, and calendar permissions are becoming more common; any weak authorization path can quickly become a real trust and security problem.
featured.insightZh: Peter Yang 提到自己遇到一个疑似日程安全漏洞：一个叫 “Nora” 的人不知道如何直接在他的日历里预约了会议，他点名 Cal.com 相关人员处理。这个小事件值得注意，因为 AI 代理、自动化预约和日历权限正在变得更常见，任何「默认可写入」或弱授权链路都会被快速放大成真实的安全与信任问题。

featured.title: Biohub: The Future of Biology is Open-Source with Mark Zuckerberg, Priscilla Chan, and Alex Rives
featured.summaryEn: Biohub’s bet is to couple frontier AI with frontier biology, using open tools and newly generated experimental data to move biology from a discovery-driven science toward something more engineered, predictable, and designable. In this No Priors episode, Mark Zuckerberg, Priscilla Chan, and Alex Rives explain why Biohub has become the core of their philanthropy. They are not claiming that Biohub itself will cure every disease; the goal is to build tools, datasets, and models that accelerate the entire scientific field. The early arc — single-cell sequencing, the Human Cell Atlas, CellByGene, and shared infrastructure — led to a broader thesis: scientific progress is constrained not only by funding, but by tooling, data, collaboration, and knowledge sharing. They argue that AI for biology is different from language modeling because the necessary data does not already exist on the internet…
featured.insightZh: Biohub 的核心赌注是把 frontier AI 与 frontier biology 绑在一起，用开放工具和新的实验数据，把生物学从发现式科学推进到更接近工程化、可预测、可设计的科学。 这期 No Priors 访谈里，Mark Zuckerberg、Priscilla Chan 和 Alex Rives 解释了 Biohub 为什么成为他们慈善工作的主轴：他们并不声称自己会直接治愈所有疾病，而是希望构建能加速整个科学共同体的工具、数据集和模型。早期 Biohub 从单细胞测序、Human Cell Atlas、CellByGene 等共享基础设施开始，逐步形成了一个思路：科学进展不只是资金问题，更是工具、数据、协作和知识共享的问题。 他们认为 AI 生物学不同于语言模型，因为互联网上没有足够的现成生物数据。要训练真正有用的世界模型，必须同时建设湿实验室能力，主动发明新的观测、成像、传感和细胞工程方法，生成此前不存在的数据。Biohub 的差异化正是把 AI 团队和 wet lab 做成一个统一系统，从蛋白质、基因、转录组到细胞表型，逐层搭建层级化的生物世界模型。 访谈后半段讨论了开放生态、药物研发和个体化医学。Zuckerberg 强调他们不相信少数中心化机构独占科学进步，而是希望把工具交到更多科学家手里；同时也承认开放生物模型需要权衡 biosafety。Alex Rives 则把下一步目标概括为 virtual cell：一个能连接 proteomic、genetic、transcriptomic 和 phenotype 层级，并能对未见过的干预做泛化预测的系统。如果这种闭环建立起来，药物设计、毒性预测、罕见病试验和个体化治疗的成本结构都可能被改写。

items.title: Nan Yu · Linear 产品负责人
items.summaryEn: Linear’s head of product Nan Yu joked that if a piece of software can freeze tech-company operations and render progress worthless, its damaging capabilities should be controlled — “import restrictions on Jira.” It is satire, not policy, but the product signal is clear: collaboration-tool complexity has become productivity debt, and AI-era teams will increasingly favor low-friction workflow systems.
items.insightZh: Linear 产品负责人 Nan Yu 用反讽方式吐槽 Jira：如果有一款软件强大到能冻结科技公司的运营、让进展停摆，那这种破坏性能力必须被控制，建议对 Jira 做进口限制。这不是严肃政策建议，而是典型产品人视角的信号：团队工具的复杂度本身已经成为生产力债务，AI 时代大家会更期待低摩擦、低配置成本的工作流系统。

items.title: Madhu Guru · 前 Google Gemini / Veo / Nano Banana 产品负责人
items.summaryEn: Madhu Guru, drawing on experience with frontier model launch reviews, explained why shipping an LLM is unlike releasing traditional software: the team is deciding what to do with a black box with effectively infinite use cases and failure modes. Labs can run evals, red-team, and debate checkpoints, yet early-access partners still uncover surprises. As models get stronger, launch decisions become harder for both labs and regulators; the goal is not certainty, but enough uncertainty reduction to ship responsibly.
items.insightZh: Madhu Guru 从多次前沿模型发布评审的经验出发，解释为什么 LLM 发布不像传统软件上线：你面对的是一个黑盒，使用场景和失败模式几乎无限。实验室可以做评测、红队、checkpoint 取舍，但早期伙伴仍会发现意料之外的行为。随着模型能力增强，发布决策会同时对实验室和监管者变得更难，核心不是消除不确定性，而是把不确定性降到足以发布的水平。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Aaron Levie’s thread connects model-layer regulation, export controls, and the rising value of multi-model routing. He argues that the Fable situation is an early preview of what AI regulation could look like if enacted at the model layer: governments may decide whether a model can be released based on capability, jailbreak risk, and safety review, slowing release cycles and making AI resemble a more sclerotic regulated industry. His preference is to regulate applied uses of AI — cyber attacks, financial risk, fra…
items.insightZh: Aaron Levie 这组推文围绕同一件事展开：模型层监管、出口控制与多模型路由会同时变得更重要。他认为 Fable 相关事件虽然像黑天鹅，但让大家提前看到了「在模型层监管 AI」会是什么样：政府可能基于模型能力、越狱风险和安全评估决定模型能否发布，结果是发布队列变慢，AI 行业变得像传统受监管行业一样迟缓。因此他主张尽可能监管 AI 的具体应用场景，而不是过早在模型层压慢整体进展。 在应用层，Levie 认为「能为具体任务选择最合适模型」的路由层会显著增值，原因包括成本优化、能力最大化和风险缓释。同一工作流里，规划和复核可能需要 frontier 模型，批量执行可以用更便宜或开源的模型；不同模型在工具使用、代码、专业知识上也会有差异；如果监管或政策导致某些模型临时受限，企业也需要跨 provider 的部署弹性。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator CEO
items.summaryEn: Garry Tan’s two tweets make the same point from different angles: AI is a new territory, and old maps no longer work. Many people learn about a model through signifiers and discourse rather than by using the thing itself. His advice is blunt: throw away the old maps and draw new ones by walking the land. For founders and enterprise leaders, that means AI strategy cannot be built on secondhand narratives; it needs direct usage, workflow experiments, and real feedback.
items.insightZh: Garry Tan 的两条推文都在强调一个判断：AI 进入了新地形，旧地图不再好用。很多人理解模型的重要性，仍然依赖外部符号、口碑和舆论，而不是亲自使用模型形成判断。他的建议很直接：扔掉旧地图，走到地面上重新画地图。对 founder 和企业决策者来说，这意味着 AI 战略不能只靠二手叙事，必须靠一线试用、工作流改造和真实反馈。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder
items.summaryEn: Zara Zhang highlighted an essay on taste and how to cultivate it, emphasizing that taste is not just personal preference; good taste requires mastery and experience. In an AI-builder context, that point matters: as generation becomes commoditized by models, differentiation shifts toward problem selection, judgment, product tradeoffs, and the ability to recognize quality.
items.insightZh: Zara Zhang 推荐了一篇关于品味及其培养方式的文章，并摘出核心观点：品味不只是个人偏好，好的品味需要掌握能力与经验积累。这个判断放在 AI builder 语境里尤其重要：当生成能力被模型商品化之后，差异化会更多来自问题选择、审美判断、产品取舍和对质量的辨别力。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: Nikunj Kothari’s founder advice was blunt: paid partnerships and boosted X views are becoming negative signals in VC group chats. He added that he wants to talk to rare application startups with live products that sit directly in the path of decisions and dollars. Read together, the signal is that investors are re-emphasizing real demand, real usage, and revenue quality; purchased attention or inflated optics increasingly count against a company.
items.insightZh: Nikunj Kothari 给 founder 的提醒很直接：在 VC 群聊里，付费合作和给 X 浏览量做 boost 正在变成负面信号。他还补了一句，如果有少数应用型 startup 已经有真实产品，并且处在「决策与预算」路径上，他愿意聊。两条合在一起看，核心是融资市场正在重新重视真实需求、真实使用和收入质量，表面增长或购买来的注意力反而会扣分。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw / OpenAI
items.summaryEn: Peter Steinberger shared a revealing agentic-coding anecdote: he received a PayPal verification text and initially thought he had been hacked, but it was just Codex signing up for a web service it needed. The signal is not only the joke; coding agents are starting to touch real accounts, payment verification, and third-party service registration. Permission design, approval checkpoints, and auditability will become more important.
items.insightZh: Peter Steinberger 的一条趣闻很好地展示了 agentic coding 的新边界：他收到 PayPal 验证短信，第一反应以为自己被黑了，结果只是 Codex 为了完成任务在注册一个它需要的 Web 服务。这里的信号不是笑点本身，而是 AI agent 已经开始触碰真实账户、支付验证和第三方服务注册这些高风险边界，权限设计、审批断点和可审计性会越来越重要。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons 合伙人
items.summaryEn: Aditya Agarwal’s two observations — a human-taken space photo and watching Brazil play Morocco at 30,000 feet via Starlink — point to the same feeling: human engineering still has a uniquely evocative power. A machine-taken photo would be cool, but a human taking it from a tin cylinder on the far side of the moon makes it different. Watching live sports in the air via Starlink makes SpaceX’s capability visceral. Beyond AI, hard-tech progress is still changing what people feel is possible.
items.insightZh: Aditya Agarwal 从太空照片和 Starlink 机上观赛这两个小观察里，表达的是同一个情绪：人类工程能力仍然有一种不可替代的震撼。照片本身很酷，但真正让它动人的是「一个人类在月球背面的飞行器里拍下了它」；在三万英尺高空用 Starlink 看比赛，也让 SpaceX 的能力变得非常具体。这类体验提醒我们，AI 之外的硬科技进步依然在改变人对可能性的感知。
